Test Input: Dirty but compiling files with known formatter/linter violations
Required Output: All target violations fixed; no new violations; semantic tests unchanged
Core Metrics: lint-clean rate, new-issue count, diff size, runtime
Initial Control: Can auto-apply only after deterministic formatter/linter confirms

Required Output: Tests compile, pass, assert meaningful behavior, and follow framework conventions
Core Metrics: compile rate, pass rate, coverage delta, mutation score, flaky rate
Initial Control: Human review required until quality is stable

Test Input: Files/modules with a symbol and dependency checklist
Required Output: Accurate purpose, inputs, outputs, side effects, risks, dependencies
Core Metrics: claim accuracy, symbol coverage, unsupported-claim count

Required Output: Build and tests pass; APIs preserved; changes remain within requested scope
Core Metrics: build rate, regression pass, AST scope adherence, diff churn
Initial Control: OpenShell sandbox plus explicit file allowlist

Test Input: Known bug with reproducer and hidden regression cases
Required Output: Explains root cause, proposes minimal patch, passes reproducer and regression suite
Core Metrics: reproducer pass, regression pass, patch precision, false-fix rate

Test Input: Stale or missing docs with API truth set
Required Output: Technically accurate, useful, non-obvious, project style compliant
Core Metrics: factual accuracy, doc build, stale-link count, reviewer acceptance

Required Output: Generated files compile and match approved structure/security defaults
Core Metrics: template conformity, build pass, security scan, manual edits required
Initial Control: Use retrieval of approved templates rather than model memory

Test Input: Questions with known supporting passages and unanswerable controls
Required Output: Correct answer with source citations or explicit abstention
Core Metrics: retrieval recall@k, answer correctness, citation precision, abstention accuracy, latency
Initial Control: No uncited operational answer in Teams
